The *Paramaṭṭhakasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 5) is the fifth chapter of the *Mahāniddesa*, an early canonical commentary preserved in the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. Rendered in English as "Exposition of the Eight on the Ultimate," the text provides a comprehensive exegetical exposition on the *Paramaṭṭhaka Sutta* (Snp 4.5) from the *Aṭṭhakavagga* [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records two translations of the work across two languages; no secondary literature passages addressing the text were identified in the search dossier [SuttaCentral].
At the passage level, SuttaCentral notes curated parallels between the *Paramaṭṭhakasuttaniddesa* and sections of the *Cūḷaniddesa*—specifically the *Tissametteyyamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 6) and the *Mettagūmāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 8)—as well as the *Dvādasa akusala* section of the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī* (Ds 2.1.6) [SuttaCentral]. Automated text-reuse analysis via DharmaNexus indicates extensive internal Pali reuse, encompassing 2,397 matching passages across 98 texts [DharmaNexus].
